# Coverage of the Daley review {#sec-review-map}

This map audits scientific scope against the table of contents of @Daley2014, using the publicly available arXiv manuscript (v1, 26 May 2014). The published journal article is *Advances in Physics* **63**, 77–149 (2014). The section labels below refer to the review, not to this book's chapter numbering.

Coverage means that the scientific methods, assumptions, and classes of applications are explained in original prose and derivations. The review's individual experimental images and numerical plots remain in their cited publications; this book supplies original explanatory figures and reproducible benchmark calculations. The bibliography is selective, with primary sources at the point of use rather than a duplication of the review's entire reference list.

The additional prerequisite material, detailed numerical laboratory, imperfect detection, and homodyne overview extend the teaching route. They are identified through their assumptions and do not turn the 2014 case studies into claims about the current experimental frontier.
